## Description

Creates the planned Inventory module (README): stock items with category, unit, pack size, reorder level and the location that holds them. Settings → Stock lists, adds and edits items.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** An admin can add, edit and retire an item; a retired item keeps its history.
- [ ] **AC2.** Each new property carries a data classification; tenant isolation tests cover the new tables.
- [ ] **AC3.** Quantities are decimals with a unit; prices are integer minor units with currency (AGENTS.md 3.4).
- [ ] **AC4.** Checked in English and Arabic, axe clean.

## Notes / open questions

- Pick up from DentalERP: field list of `InventoryItem` and `InventoryCategory` in prisma/schema.prisma; screen flow of app/(dashboard)/inventory. Data to take: none (its categories are dental only).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
